questions.question: Six friends, C, E, G, I, K and M, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre and at equal distance from each other (not necessarily in the same order). E is second to the right of C. K is to the immediate right of G. G and I are facing towards each other. Moving towards the left of I, how many friends are sitting between I and M?
questions.solution:
E is second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120df1c825ca392a712eb3acd2f9c5946921c774d616d19a77bf416bf637f78e.png] 

G and I are facing towards each other. So, this case is possible only when G is sitting second left of C.

K is to the immediate right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f53270299779161bbf821c5883d3e858d4680d3aeceb0b1ffce801f9b37c6a0e.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is “3”.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some K are M.

II. No T is M.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some T are K.

II. Some M are K.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bed3ee09c908f37065d31a013eb87865ae5b2f6021523caaf64c71fcb94221c.png] **

**Conclusion:**

I. Some T are K → False (There are no direct relation given. Hence, false)

II. Some M are K → True (Some K are M)

Thus, only conclusion II follow.

questions.question: If the two signs, '× and ÷' are interchanged, which of the following equations will be correct?
questions.solution:
When we interchanged × and ÷ and check the options:-

1) 14 + 9 ÷ 23 × 3 = 83 → 14 + 9 × 23 ÷ 3 = 83

14 + 3 × 23 = 83

14 + 69 = 83

83 = 83

Option 1 is correct. So, we don’t need to check other options.

Thus, the correct answer is “14 + 9 × 23 ÷ 3 = 83”.

questions.question: Five persons, F, J, N, R and V, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). J is to the immediate left of F. N is second to the left of F. V is second to the left of J. Who is sitting second to the right of J?
questions.solution:
J is to the immediate left of F.

N is second to the left of F.

V is second to the left of J.

R is sitting on remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f014a84d7c457d7bdfde5f9d154f197d591e44fc087885e8cbb6746c714e763.png] 

So, R is sitting second to the right of J.

Thus, the correct answer is “R”.

questions.question:
If digits 2 and 1 interchange with each other then what will be the value of the following equation?

9 + 6 ÷ 4 × 21 – 5 = ?
questions.solution:
If digit 2 and 1 interchange with each other

then, equation 9 + 6 ÷ 4 × 21 – 5 = ? becomes

9 + 6 ÷ 4 × 12 – 5

= 9 + 6over4 × 12 – 5

= 9 + 18 - 5

= 27 - 5

= 22

Thus, the correct answer is “**22**”.
